name: Calendar (Google Calendar MCP)
risks: Community-maintained: review the code before installing.
Write access can modify your real agenda — keep read-only until trusted.
notes: Enables morning-brief routines that include today's agenda.

dataMapping.install: npm i -g @cocal/google-calendar-mcp  (or run it through npx, as configured here)
setup: Create an OAuth desktop client in Google Cloud and download the credentials JSON.
Export GOOGLE_OAUTH_CREDENTIALS=<path to that JSON> in the environment of the MordomoOS service (never in a routine file).
Run the server once by hand to complete the browser consent flow; the token is cached by the server itself.
Allowlist the executable: add "npx" to settings.connectors.allowedCommands.
MordomoOS only ever calls the read tool declared above; writes stay behind the approval gate.
